# apple_notify_beta_testers (Action)

Notifies a build's testers that it is available, for builds whose automatic notification is off (`apple_build_beta_detail`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run with: terraform apply -invoke=action.apple_notify_beta_testers.latest
action "apple_notify_beta_testers" "latest" {
  config {
    build_id = data.apple_build.latest.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `build_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build, e.g. `data.apple_build.latest.id`.
